# Gcore Edge Proxy

> Review Edge Proxy DDoS protection concepts - Anycast routing, application profiles, protection templates, PROXY protocol, and filtering at CDN edge PoPs.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/overview.md): Review Edge Proxy DDoS protection concepts - Anycast routing, application profiles, protection templates, PROXY protocol, and filtering at CDN edge PoPs.
- [Setup and configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/setup-and-configuration.md): Configure Edge Proxy DDoS protection using a four-step wizard - enter server details, select game applications and a protection template, set ports, and deploy.
- [Manage Edge Proxy](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/manage-edge-proxy.md): Manage Edge Proxy servers - enable or disable protection, edit settings and proxy protocol, delete servers, and monitor traffic metrics.
- [FAQs and troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/faqs-and-troubleshooting.md): Troubleshoot Edge Proxy issues and find answers to common questions about setup, DNS configuration, application types, and traffic connectivity.
